scheme_name: Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Applicant must be a regular student
Student must be studying at a government or recognized non‑government higher or technical institute in Rajasthan
Student must have passed the 12th examination from the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education in the current year with at least 60% marks and be within the top one lakh of the board’s merit list
Student must not be receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance from the Government of India or the State Government
Student must have a savings account in a nationalized bank
Applicant must possess a valid Aadhaar card
Student must have a Jan Aadhaar Card (Bhamashah Card)
benefits_summary: ₹500 per month for up to 10 months (₹5,000 annually) for general students, and ₹1,000 per month for up to 10 months (₹10,000 annually) for disabled students (disability ≥40%) for a maximum of five years.
documents_required: Proof of savings account in a nationalized bank
